title: First piece: Ode to Joy
summary: Beethoven's most famous tune, in the eight notes you know.

steps.title: Your first piece
text: **Ode to Joy** is the main theme of the last movement of Beethoven's Ninth Symphony, first performed in 1824.
It moves almost entirely by step, which makes it a good first piece to read.

steps.title: The first phrase
text: Here are the first four bars. Notice the repeated notes, and the half note that ends bar 4.
The rhythm is slightly simplified here so that it uses only the note lengths you know.

steps.title: First half
text: Bars 1 to 4. Read it through, listen if you like, then press **Your turn**.

steps.title: Second half
text: Bars 5 to 8 are almost the same. Only the last bar changes, to bring the tune home to **C**.

steps.title: The whole piece
text: All eight bars. The music runs onto a second line, and the page follows you as you play.
